record.statement: For a RWRE satisfying (E) and (IID) and any direction l, is P_0[A_l] in {0,1}, where A_l is the event of transience in direction l? Known for d = 1 and d = 2 (Zerner-Merkl).
record.title: Zero-one law for directional transience in dimensions d >= 3

record.author: claude-probability-1000-continue-0907
record.correction_note: Codex review 12:02: A_l and A_{-l} are disjoint by definition; the content of Zerner-Merkl is the 0-1 law for A_l.
record.method: Analyse where the Zerner-Merkl planar argument uses d = 2.
record.obstruction: Planarity is essential to the d = 2 proof; no substitute in d >= 3.
record.result: Zerner-Merkl show P_0[A_l intersection A_{-l}] = 0 using that in d = 2 two independent walks in the same environment started at distant points on a line perpendicular to l must, with positive probability, have paths that intersect (planarity), which lets one derive a contradiction from the walk going to +infinity and -infinity in direction l with positive probability each. In d >= 3 paths of two walks need not intersect, and the known partial result (Kalikow's 0-1 law: P_0[A_l union A_{-l}] in {0,1}) does not exclude the mixed event. A candidate counterexample structure in d >= 3 would be an i.i.d. environment where the walk is guided to +l or -l depending on a local feature it meets first; the i.i.d. assumption and the fact that the walk visits infinitely many independent regions make such a persistent memory implausible but not provably impossible: the walk in direction +l sees fresh environment forever, and the event that it turns around is a tail event of the walk but not of the environment. I checked that the natural martingale argument (P_omega(A_l) as a function of the environment at the current position) fails because P_omega(A_l) is not measurable with respect to a finite region. No result.

record.author: claude-probability-1000-continue-0907
record.independent_check: Correction checked line by line against the source and the holder's message by the Fable agent; the holder's claim was taken as a lead, not as authority.
record.key_identity: Zerner-Merkl (d=2): P_0(A_l) in {0,1}; Kalikow (all d): P_0(A_l union A_{-l}) in {0,1}; d >= 3 directional law open.
record.method: Codex review 12:02: A_l and A_{-l} are disjoint by definition; the content of Zerner-Merkl is the 0-1 law for A_l.
record.obstruction: see A001 for the standing obstruction
record.result: CORRECTION of C0044-A001's first sentence. The events {X_n . l -> +infinity} and {X_n . l -> -infinity} are disjoint by definition, so 'Zerner-Merkl show P(A_l intersect A_{-l}) = 0' is empty; what Zerner-Merkl prove in d = 2 is P_0(A_l) in {0,1}, using planarity to show two walks in the same environment intersect, which is what A001 then describes. The reduction (planarity essential; no d >= 3 substitute; no finite-region measurability for the natural martingale) stands.

peer_primary_source_files.first_page_excerpt:
A directional zero–one law
under strict ellipticity
OpenAI
September 23, 2026
Abstract
We prove the directional zero–one conjecture for nearest-neighbor random walks in
independent and identically distributed strictly elliptic environments on Zd, d ≥3: the
probability of escape in each fixed nonzero real direction is zero or one. Only strict
positivity of the transition probabilities is required; no uniform lower bound or moment
assumption is imposed.

mesh_help:
usage: agent_mesh.py [-h] [--json]
                     {hello,pulse,claim,release,assert,send,handoff,handoff-accept,handoff-reject,handoff-cancel,inbox,ack,receipts,digest,campaign-start,campaign-join,task-add,task-take,task-set,task-release,task-reassign,bye,status,doctor,prune,purge} ...

Coordinate Claude, Codex, and autonomous agents through the shared brain.

positional arguments:
  {hello,pulse,claim,release,assert,send,handoff,handoff-accept,handoff-reject,handoff-cancel,inbox,ack,receipts,digest,campaign-start,campaign-join,task-add,task-take,task-set,task-release,task-reassign,bye,status,doctor,prune,purge}
    hello               register or refresh an agent identity
    pulse               heartbeat; renew the agent and all its live claims
    claim               atomically acquire one or more resource leases
    release             release resource leases
    assert              prove live covering write leases immediately before
                        mutation
    send                send a message to an agent or all
    handoff             send a structured evidence handoff requiring
                        acceptance
    handoff-accept      accept a structured handoff after inspecting evidence
    handoff-reject      reject a handoff and keep ownership with the sender
    handoff-cancel      sender cancels an unanswered handoff before releasing
                        ownership
    inbox               read this agent's mailbox
    ack                 acknowledge mailbox messages
    receipts            inspect delivery/ack state for messages you sent
    digest              prompt-sized view of siblings, mail, claims, and work
    campaign-start      start a timed collaboration campaign
    campaign-join       join an active campaign
    task-add            add work to the shared board
    task-take           atomically take an open task
    task-set            update a task you own
    task-release        return a task you own to the open board
    task-reassign       campaign owner assigns a live task to another member
    bye                 publish final status and optionally release all claims
    status              show the live collaboration board
    doctor              integrity and liveness checks
    prune               expire dead sessions and leases
    purge               delete old acknowledged/closed operational history

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --json                machine-readable JSON where applicable

Typical flow:
  agent_mesh.py hello --agent codex-review --runtime codex --task "review parser"
  agent_mesh.py claim --agent codex-review --resource C:\repo\parser.py --mode write --purpose "fix parser"
  agent_mesh.py digest --agent codex-review
  agent_mesh.py release --agent codex-review --all
  agent_mesh.py bye --agent codex-review --status done --summary "tests pass"
